name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-image-wuyinkeji
description: Wuyinkeji (api.wuyinkeji.com) async image-generation provider for the DeepSeek Harness image seam (ctx.image) — submits text prompts to the public GPT-Image-2.5 task endpoint, polls its result-detail endpoint until the task settles, downloads the URL-scoped answer into raw bytes, reads the API key from a named environment variable at call time, and surfaces endpoint failures as typed IMAGE_PROVIDER_FAILED errors with no local fallback
